answer: In an AI agent economy, Proof-of-Stake with Identity Locking resists Sybil attacks. Agents must lock significant tokenized assets, depicted as entries on the immutable Atlas, to gain weight in consensus, letting them submit only one vote (singular 'sonnet'). Attempting a Sybil attack requires duplicating these locked holdings for each identity, locking additional sable-equivalent value, thus deterring adversaries through substantial capital expenditure and staking power dilution.
